name: Emergency Room Triage Desk
role: You are an ER triage nurse on a busy night shift.
speaker: Nurse Morgan

tasks.goal: Describe acute symptoms and pain level
tasks.hint: State what is wrong clearly and rate your pain.
tasks.done_when: Learner described specific physical symptoms and indicated severity or pain level.

Japanese.goal: 急な症状と痛みの程度を説明する
Japanese.hint: どこが悪いのかをはっきり伝え、痛みの強さを数字で伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide medical history and allergy info
tasks.hint: Mention any existing medical conditions or allergies.
tasks.done_when: Learner disclosed relevant medical history or drug allergies.

Japanese.goal: 既往歴とアレルギーについて伝える
Japanese.hint: 持病やアレルギーがあれば伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about estimated wait time
tasks.hint: Ask how long before a doctor can examine you.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the estimated waiting time for medical assessment.

Japanese.goal: 待ち時間の目安を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 医師に診てもらえるまでどのくらいかかるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'escalate'
tasks.hint: To escalate means to increase rapidly or become more intense. Explain that severe abdominal pain began to escalate an hour ago.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'escalate'.

Japanese.goal: 「悪化」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 悪化とは、状態が急に悪くなったり激しくなったりすることです。ひどい腹痛が1時間前から悪化してきたと説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request pain management options while waiting
tasks.hint: Ask if there is safe temporary pain relief available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for pain relief medication or pain management options while waiting.

Japanese.goal: 待っている間の痛みの対処法について頼む
Japanese.hint: 一時的に使える安全な痛み止めがあるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain why your condition requires urgent evaluation
tasks.hint: State clearly why you cannot wait several hours.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained why their symptoms require immediate medical attention.

Japanese.goal: 自分の症状が緊急の診察を必要とする理由を説明する
Japanese.hint: なぜ何時間も待てないのか、はっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if family or companions can wait in the triage room
tasks.hint: Inquire about visitor policies in the ER.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if a companion or family member is permitted to stay with them.

Japanese.goal: 家族や付き添いの人がトリアージ室で待てるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 救急外来の面会のルールについて聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Describe sensation of numbness in extremities
tasks.hint: Describe experiencing loss of feeling or tingling.
tasks.done_when: Learner described experiencing numbness or loss of sensation.
tasks.scene_hint: Heart rate monitors beep steadily as an orderly pushes a gurney.

Japanese.goal: 手足のしびれの感覚を説明する
Japanese.hint: 感覚がなくなったり、ピリピリしたりすることを説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify insurance co-pay or registration requirements
tasks.hint: Ask about administrative check-in documents.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about administrative check-in or insurance documentation.

Japanese.goal: 保険の自己負担額や受付に必要なものを確認する
Japanese.hint: 受付の手続きに必要な書類について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request a glass of water and check if fasting is required
tasks.hint: Ask if you are allowed to drink water before tests.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested water or inquired about eating/fasting restrictions.

Japanese.goal: 水を一杯頼み、絶食が必要かどうか確認する
Japanese.hint: 検査の前に水を飲んでもいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for a wheelchair or mobility assistance
tasks.hint: Request assistance moving to the waiting bay.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a wheelchair or physical mobility assistance.

Japanese.goal: 車いすや移動の手助けを頼む
Japanese.hint: 待合スペースまで移動するのを手伝ってほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'vital'
tasks.hint: Vital signs include blood pressure and heart rate. Ask if your vitals can be checked again.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'vital'.

Japanese.goal: 「バイタル」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: バイタルには血圧や心拍数が含まれます。バイタルをもう一度測ってもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate priority assessment after symptoms worsen
tasks.hint: Politely inform the nurse that your condition has escalated.
tasks.done_when: Learner communicated worsening symptoms and requested re-evaluation of triage priority.

Japanese.goal: 症状が悪化したので、優先して診てもらえるよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 症状が悪化したことを、丁寧に看護師に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm contact details for test result notification
tasks.hint: Ensure the hospital has your updated phone number.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified contact details for follow-up or test notification.

Japanese.goal: 検査結果の連絡先を確認する
Japanese.hint: 病院に最新の電話番号が登録されているか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the triage nurse for their care
tasks.hint: Conclude the intake politely.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the nurse for their care or assistance.

Japanese.goal: トリアージの看護師に対応のお礼を言う
Japanese.hint: 丁寧に受付のやりとりを締めくくりましょう。

tasks.goal: Specify the exact time when pain first started
tasks.hint: State the time of onset for your symptoms.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated the specific time or hour when symptoms began.

Japanese.goal: 痛みが始まった正確な時刻を伝える
Japanese.hint: 症状が始まった時刻を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: State whether you arrived by ambulance or self-transport
tasks.hint: Inform the intake desk how you reached the hospital.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified their mode of arrival at the emergency department.

Japanese.goal: 救急車で来たか自力で来たかを伝える
Japanese.hint: どうやって病院に来たかを受付に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide primary emergency contact details
tasks.hint: Give the phone number of a relative or emergency contact.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided emergency contact details for family or next of kin.

Japanese.goal: 主な緊急連絡先を伝える
Japanese.hint: 家族や緊急連絡先の電話番号を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm patient wristband details before moving to waiting bay
tasks.hint: Check that your name and DOB on the wristband are correct.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified information printed on their hospital ID wristband.

Japanese.goal: 待合スペースに移る前に、患者用リストバンドの内容を確認する
Japanese.hint: リストバンドの名前と生年月日が正しいか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask where to sit while waiting for your call number
tasks.hint: Inquire about designated waiting zone placement.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where to wait after completing initial triage intake.

Japanese.goal: 番号が呼ばれるまでどこに座って待てばいいか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 決められた待合エリアの場所を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire how you will be notified when a doctor is ready
tasks.hint: Ask if your name will be called or displayed on screen.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how patients are called from the waiting room.

Japanese.goal: 医師の準備ができたらどのように知らせてもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 名前を呼ばれるのか、画面に表示されるのか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for a copy of your initial triage intake summary
tasks.hint: Request a printed record of your intake vitals.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a copy of initial triage documentation.

Japanese.goal: 最初のトリアージの受付記録の控えを頼む
Japanese.hint: 受付時に測ったバイタルの記録を印刷してもらえるよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm procedure if symptoms worsen while sitting in waiting room
tasks.hint: Ask what to do if pain escalates while waiting.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to notify staff if condition deteriorates in waiting area.

Japanese.goal: 待合室にいる間に症状が悪化した場合の対応を確認する
Japanese.hint: 待っている間に痛みがひどくなったらどうすればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify parking validation or transportation arrangements
tasks.hint: Ask if ER parking can be validated.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about parking validation or post-discharge transport.

Japanese.goal: 駐車料金の割引や帰りの交通手段について確認する
Japanese.hint: 救急外来の駐車料金を割引してもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm intake process is complete before leaving the counter
tasks.hint: Ensure all initial paperwork is finalized.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed that initial registration steps are complete.

Japanese.goal: 受付カウンターを離れる前に、受付の手続きが済んだことを確認する
Japanese.hint: 最初の書類がすべて終わっているか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'nausea'
tasks.hint: Nausea means feeling sick to your stomach. Mention experiencing nausea.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'nausea'.

Japanese.goal: 「吐き気」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 吐き気とは、胃がむかむかして気分が悪いことです。吐き気があると伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'observation'
tasks.hint: Observation refers to monitoring a patient's medical condition over time. Ask if overnight observation is required.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'observation'.

Japanese.goal: 「経過観察」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 経過観察とは、患者の状態を時間をかけて見守ることです。一晩の経過観察が必要か聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'severity'
tasks.hint: Severity refers to how severe pain or symptoms are. Ask how symptom severity is rated.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'severity'.

Japanese.goal: 「重症度」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 重症度とは、痛みや症状がどれくらいひどいかということです。症状の重症度はどのように判定するのか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Detail whether pain is sharp, dull, or throbbing
tasks.hint: Describe the character of your pain when asked.
tasks.done_when: Learner described the specific qualitative nature of their pain.
tasks.scene_hint: An overhead loudspeaker pages Dr. Vasquez to Trauma Bay 3 as rain beats against the ER glass doors.

Japanese.goal: 痛みが鋭いか、鈍いか、ズキズキするかを詳しく伝える
Japanese.hint: 聞かれたら、痛みの種類を説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Dispute long estimated wait time based on chest discomfort
tasks.hint: Explain why waiting extended hours poses health risk.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern regarding wait length given specific symptoms.
tasks.scene_hint: The scent of antiseptic hangs heavy in the hallway while automated doors click open and shut.

Japanese.goal: 胸の不快感があるので、長い待ち時間に異議を唱える
Japanese.hint: 長時間待つことがなぜ健康上危険なのか説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request an interpreter or language assistance service
tasks.hint: Ask for medical translation support.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested language translation support or interpreter service.
tasks.scene_hint: A digital queue display on the wall flashes ticket numbers in bright blue LEDs.

Japanese.goal: 通訳や言語サポートのサービスを頼む
Japanese.hint: 医療通訳のサポートをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Describe difficulty breathing when lying flat
tasks.hint: Explain positional changes in symptom severity.
tasks.done_when: Learner described how posture affects symptom intensity.
tasks.scene_hint: Outside the intake booth, a paramedic team rolls an empty gurney down the tiled corridor.

Japanese.goal: あおむけに寝ると息が苦しいことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 体勢によって症状の重さが変わることを説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide employer worker compensation claim details if applicable
tasks.hint: Mention if injury occurred on the job.
tasks.done_when: Learner indicated if injury is job-related for workers compensation.
tasks.scene_hint: Triage intake folders with color-coded priority tabs stack beside the registration terminal.

Japanese.goal: 該当する場合、勤務先の労災申請の情報を伝える
Japanese.hint: 仕事中のけがであれば、そう伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for an ice pack to reduce swelling on injured joint
tasks.hint: Request cold compress application.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested an ice pack for localized swelling.
tasks.scene_hint: A pulse oximeter clips onto your index finger, displaying red blood oxygen figures.

Japanese.goal: けがをした関節の腫れを抑えるために保冷剤を頼む
Japanese.hint: 冷やすものを当ててほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain that symptom started suddenly during physical exercise
tasks.hint: Provide trigger context for symptom onset.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained activity context surrounding symptom onset.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft rubber wheels squeak against squeaky clean linoleum as a nurse passes with a tray of IV supplies.

Japanese.goal: 運動中に急に症状が出たことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 症状が出たときのきっかけを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Describe visual disturbances such as blurry vision or flashes
tasks.hint: Detail optical symptoms experienced.
tasks.done_when: Learner described specific visual disturbances or vision changes.
tasks.scene_hint: Fluorescent ceiling lights hum faintly above a rack of laminated patient rights pamphlets.

Japanese.goal: かすみ目や光が見えるなど、目の異常を説明する
Japanese.hint: 目に起きている症状を詳しく伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about hospital visitor badge requirements
tasks.hint: Ask how family members obtain guest passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about visitor pass procedures.
tasks.scene_hint: The triage nurse adjusts her stethoscope around her neck while typing on a dual-monitor workstation.

Japanese.goal: 病院の面会者バッジが必要かどうか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 家族が面会証をどうやってもらえるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if private consultation space is available for sensitive topic
tasks.hint: Request privacy for medical discussion.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a private room for sensitive medical discussion.
tasks.scene_hint: Behind the acrylic glass partition, a printer clicks repeatedly while printing patient wristbands.

Japanese.goal: 話しにくい内容なので、個室で相談できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 医療の話をするのにプライバシーを守ってほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about estimated time for blood test laboratory results
tasks.hint: Inquire how long lab processing takes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about processing times for laboratory blood work.
tasks.scene_hint: A wall-mounted blood pressure cuff inflates with a steady mechanical hiss.

Japanese.goal: 血液検査の結果が出るまでの時間の目安を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 検査にどのくらい時間がかかるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Report localized swelling and redness around wound site
tasks.hint: Describe physical appearance of skin injury.
tasks.done_when: Learner described localized swelling, redness, or inflammation.
tasks.scene_hint: Subdued hushed voices fill the waiting area as an ambulance siren fades away outside.

Japanese.goal: 傷のまわりが部分的に腫れて赤くなっていることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 皮膚の傷の見た目を説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: List all daily prescription medications currently taken
tasks.hint: Provide your medication list in response to nurse inquiry.
tasks.done_when: Learner itemized current prescription medications and dosages.

Japanese.goal: 毎日飲んでいる処方薬をすべて伝える
Japanese.hint: 看護師に聞かれたら、飲んでいる薬の一覧を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain that pain radiates into your left shoulder
tasks.hint: Describe the radiation pattern of symptoms.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained that pain extends to another body part.

Japanese.goal: 痛みが左肩まで広がっていることを説明する
Japanese.hint: 症状がどこまで広がっているかを説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify whether you have experienced dizziness or loss of consciousness
tasks.hint: Answer questions about neurological symptoms.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified presence or absence of lightheadedness or blackout episodes.

Japanese.goal: めまいや意識を失ったことがあるかどうかをはっきり伝える
Japanese.hint: 神経の症状についての質問に答えましょう。

tasks.goal: State whether you have eaten or drunk liquids recently
tasks.hint: Provide details on recent oral intake.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported time and content of last food or liquid intake.

Japanese.goal: 最近何か食べたり飲んだりしたかどうかを伝える
Japanese.hint: 最近口にしたものについて詳しく伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain previous adverse reactions to pain medication
tasks.hint: Warn staff about past adverse drug reactions.
tasks.done_when: Learner detailed past negative reactions to specific medicines.

Japanese.goal: 以前痛み止めで副作用が出たことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 過去の薬の副作用について、スタッフに注意してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify whether minor dependents are allowed in triage
tasks.hint: Ask about childcare policies during intake.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about policies regarding accompanying children in the ER.

Japanese.goal: トリアージに小さい子どもを連れて入れるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 受付の間、子どもをどうすればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Report recent international travel history
tasks.hint: Disclose travel to regions with active health advisories.
tasks.done_when: Learner disclosed recent international travel locations.

Japanese.goal: 最近の海外渡航歴を伝える
Japanese.hint: 健康上の注意情報が出ている地域に行ったことがあれば伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request update on intake progress after one hour wait
tasks.hint: Politely ask staff for status update.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a status update on triage queue progression.

Japanese.goal: 1時間待ったあとで、受付の進み具合を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 今どうなっているか、丁寧にスタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if blood work or diagnostic imaging will be ordered
tasks.hint: Inquire about expected lab tests.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if blood tests, X-rays, or scans will be conducted.

Japanese.goal: 血液検査や画像検査をするかどうか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: どんな検査をする予定か聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if tetanus vaccination is required for deep cut
tasks.hint: Ask about preventative immunization for puncture wound.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked whether a tetanus booster is recommended.

Japanese.goal: 深い切り傷に破傷風の予防接種が必要か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 刺し傷に予防接種が必要かどうか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify payment options for uninsured or self-pay patients
tasks.hint: Inquire about financial counseling options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about payment assistance or self-pay options.

Japanese.goal: 保険に入っていない患者や自費の患者の支払い方法を確認する
Japanese.hint: 支払いについて相談できる窓口があるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: State whether you have a copy of your advance healthcare directive
tasks.hint: Mention existence of medical power of attorney.
tasks.done_when: Learner noted availability of advance directive or proxy documents.

Japanese.goal: 事前指示書の写しを持っているかどうかを伝える
Japanese.hint: 医療に関する代理人を決めてあるなら、そのことを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Report recent surgical history or medical procedures
tasks.hint: Disclose any surgeries within the last six months.
tasks.done_when: Learner disclosed recent surgeries or invasive procedures.

Japanese.goal: 最近の手術歴や医療処置を伝える
Japanese.hint: この6か月以内に受けた手術があれば伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about pediatric or specialized care availability
tasks.hint: Inquire if specialized doctors are on call.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about specialist availability in the emergency department.

Japanese.goal: 小児科や専門の診療が受けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 専門の医師が待機しているか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request warm blankets to manage chills or shivering
tasks.hint: Ask staff for extra blankets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for warm blankets due to feeling cold or shivering.

Japanese.goal: 寒気や震えがあるので温かい毛布を頼む
Japanese.hint: スタッフに毛布をもう一枚お願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about hospital policy on phone use in waiting area
tasks.hint: Ask where mobile phones can be used.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cellular phone regulations inside the clinic.

Japanese.goal: 待合エリアでの携帯電話の使用について病院の規則を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 携帯電話をどこで使えるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if eye examination equipment is available in ER
tasks.hint: Inquire about specialized diagnostic tools.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about specific diagnostic tools for eye or ENT issues.

Japanese.goal: 救急外来に目の検査の機器があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 専門の検査機器があるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance walking to the restroom
tasks.hint: Request staff aid for physical movement.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked staff for physical guidance or assistance to restroom.

Japanese.goal: トイレまで歩くのを手伝ってほしいと頼む
Japanese.hint: 移動するのにスタッフの手助けをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Report feeling lightheaded when standing up
tasks.hint: Describe orthostatic symptoms to the nurse.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported lightheadedness or dizziness upon standing.

Japanese.goal: 立ち上がるとふらっとすることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 立ちくらみの症状を看護師に説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify whether pharmacy on site can fill discharge prescriptions
tasks.hint: Ask about outpatient pharmacy location.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about on-site pharmacy services.

Japanese.goal: 退院時の処方薬を院内の薬局でもらえるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 外来用の薬局の場所を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Explain that over-the-counter medication provided no relief
tasks.hint: Inform nurse about attempted treatments.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated that self-administered medicine failed to relieve pain.

Japanese.goal: 市販薬を飲んだが効かなかったことを説明する
Japanese.hint: 自分で試した対処法を看護師に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Disclose history of asthma or respiratory conditions
tasks.hint: Share relevant chronic condition background.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned underlying respiratory or chronic conditions.

Japanese.goal: ぜんそくや呼吸器の病気の既往歴を伝える
Japanese.hint: 関係のある持病について伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request sanitizing wipes or hand sanitizer at desk
tasks.hint: Ask for hygiene products.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested sanitizing supplies at intake desk.

Japanese.goal: 受付で除菌シートや手指消毒液を頼む
Japanese.hint: 衛生用品をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on leaving ER premises temporarily while waiting
tasks.hint: Ask if leaving waiting room affects queue position.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked whether stepping outside affects waiting list status.

Japanese.goal: 待っている間に一時的に救急外来の外に出てもいいか確認する
Japanese.hint: 待合室を離れると順番に影響するか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if cardiac monitoring will be conducted during wait
tasks.hint: Inquire about telemetry or heart monitoring.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if heart monitoring is required while waiting.

Japanese.goal: 待っている間に心電図モニターをつけるかどうか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 心臓のモニタリングをするかどうか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm primary care physician name for records transfer
tasks.hint: Provide doctor's name for clinical record sharing.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided primary care provider details for record sharing.

Japanese.goal: 記録を送るために、かかりつけ医の名前を確認する
Japanese.hint: 診療記録を共有するために、医師の名前を伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request earplugs or quiet area due to sensory overload
tasks.hint: Ask for noise reduction assistance.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a quieter seating area or noise protection.

Japanese.goal: 刺激が多すぎてつらいので、耳栓か静かな場所を頼む
Japanese.hint: 騒音を減らすための手助けをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Express concern regarding potential exposure to contagious illness
